alexh-adobe-fonts-skill-root.description: Search Adobe Fonts (Typekit) families, create and manage web kits/projects, and return ready-to-use embed snippets plus CSS font-family values. Use when the user asks to find Adobe fonts, compare font options, set up Typekit for a website, add fonts to kits, publish kits, or generate copy/paste font embed metadata for Codex, Claude Code, or OpenCode workflows.
alexh-adobe-fonts-skill-root.author: Alex Haynes
